pr.body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add an independently source-reviewed authentic-input loader, complete retained-value serializer consumer, and separate output validator under `research/h25-authentic-serializer-20261031/`. The package carries the exact original serializer/reference and controls plus all three authentic H25 input transports. This first incremental commit is a source proposal: controls and complete replay have not run, the execution envelope and parent admission remain pending, and O03 is not qualified. No caller, timing, memory, kappa or whole-goal gain is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Explicit user-directed continuation of the verification data-handling work. Base: `a7638a4ce2a29947457ae8d6bf8cd70a234dfeac`. Input provenance: PR #6029 at `e05aad954689d0ee21baff19b4674f1fcb2e838f`. Extends the bounded serializer extraction in #6326; #6328 is a separate inventory-only digest contribution. Scope is refined to authentic retained-value serialization, without fresh scientific construction or resuming paused cache/retention research.

## Validation

Independent source review accepted the loader and its 39 ordered control cases per mode, and the complete consumer/independent validator with the unchanged 70 original plus 15 new consumer cases per mode. These are authored controls, not executed results. Independent export review checked all 51 files / 17,384,947 bytes, exact source copies, SHA256 and Git blob identities. Parent verified the three original input blob IDs and sizes in both upstream and fork.

See `README.md`, `TASK.json`, `loader/API-v1.md`, `consumer/README-v1.md`, the carried I1/I2 reviews, and the exact manifests. CLI forms describe interfaces only; a checkout or fabricated custody JSON is not an admitted run. Git modes do not preserve the required fresh immutable execution custody. Hosted planning, if successful, must be distinguished from replay.

## Credit

Preserves PR #6029, #6326 and their cumulative construction/reference/control provenance. Substantial implementation and independent source review assistance used GPT-6.1-sol agents at high effort. Existing source licensing and attribution are retained.

## Open next questions

Complete and independently review actual runtime/custody/observer/guard source and the exact fixed operation. Then run the original and new controls, one first full baseline and one first full candidate, and independent full-output validation under the existing 180-second / sampled 1-GiB limits. Preserve all failures and report inclusive costs and gain/no-gain/regression honestly. A later incremental evidence commit will record the resulting disposition; historical and final metadata/publication timing gaps remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO.
